headline: Mukul Agarwal buys stake in Apsis Aerocom while cutting KRN Heat holdings
hook: New portfolio addition for ace investor
summary: Ace investor Mukul Agarwal has acquired a 1.2 percent stake in precision engineering firm Apsis Aerocom for his Rs 8,000 crore portfolio. The stock has delivered a 470 percent return since its March 2026 debut. Concurrently, he reduced his exposure to KRN Heat Exchanger following a 61 percent rally over the past year. Retail investors tracking celebrity investor portfolios often monitor these quarterly shareholding pattern changes for investment cues.
why_it_matters: Celebrity investor portfolio movements signal potential retail stock interest.
winners_losers: Apsis Aerocom gains / KRN Heat hurt
